name: TA / Recruiting Practitioner
lens: An in-house recruiter or TA specialist sizing up their own earning potential against agency, retained, and RPO recruiters — wants exact commission percentages and dollar ranges by role/seniority to benchmark their pay or negotiate fee terms with outside recruiters they work with.
why: The keyword and angle ask what recruiters themselves earn per hire, not employer cost-per-hire; of the four buyer-side personas, the TA/Recruiting Practitioner is the one who IS a recruiter and acts on this data (career benchmarking, vendor fee negotiation), while the other three personas own budget/strategy/compliance decisions, not recruiter compensation itself.
